title: Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1985

sections.shortTitle: Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1985
ACT VII OF 1985
KORANGI FISHERIES HARBOUR AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act to amend the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary. Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority
(Amendment) Act, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1985
sections.description:
Amendment of section 27, Ordinance XVI of 1982

ACT VII OF 1985
ACT VII OF 1985
KORANGI FISHERIES HARBOUR AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1985
An Act to amend the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary. Part I, 27th July, 1985]
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of
the President on the 11th July, 1985, and is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 27,
Ordinance XVI of 1982.----In
the Korangi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1982 (XVI of 1982), in
section 27, in subsection (1), for the full stop at the end a colon shall be
substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely :-
"Provided that a suit instituted without
such notice shall not be dismissed only on that ground, but the plaintiff shall
not be entitled to any costs.".
